LTTH Version 1.4.1 Release Notes

LTTH remains at 1.4.1. Stream Monsters 1.11.1 is published separately as a verified Stable plugin package.

- STABLE: Stream Monsters has completed its Open Beta phase while retaining the streamalchemy plugin ID and all existing player data
- NEW: Fresh Stream Monsters setups use a 90-second incubation default while every stored creator duration and existing egg ready_at remain unchanged
- NEW: Deutsch and English are active by default, with one or two overlay languages selectable from German, English, Spanish and French
- NEW: Portrait Arcade Rally reserves the upper 74 percent for gameplay and the lower 26 percent for TikTok chat
- IMPROVED: Rules v8 battles continue until K.O. or forfeit; late Arena Collapse prevents endless defensive loops without changing stored monster values
- IMPROVED: Sealed A/B/C choices, readable action cards, exact player and monster stat prompts, and deterministic replay recovery make the next action explicit
- FIXED: Durable provider-event receipts prevent duplicate GCCE or fallback commands and duplicate overlay result cards
- SECURITY: Public battle events no longer expose internal monster identifiers
- ACCESSIBILITY: Creator and overlay controls are fully localized in German, English, Spanish and French with complete ARIA labels
- FAIRNESS: Gifts affect eggs, timing and presentation only; rating limits remain separate from XP and permanent progress
- COMPATIBILITY: Player data, old configs, eggs, monsters, replays and every published archive through 1.11.0 remain preserved
- PACKAGE: streamalchemy-1.11.1.zip is bound to audited source commit fd8583a2f04e377c88ebb7f5e5cd419fbcac64d4 with SHA-256 46918c6c52bd0bcae123950e038e4db3feadd30fa1bc514758e8e411d00c3b60
